Meet the space travelers of Crew-13!

NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk, and cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov are scheduled to lift off to the @ISS at 11:10 a.m. EDT (1510 UTC) on Oct. 1.

You can watch them launch with us here on Instagram — or check out our link in bio for other ways to tune in!
